document.title: Motor Vehicles (Driving) Regulations, 2017
document.issued_by: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, Government of India
document.authority: Section 118 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (59 of 1988)

kerala_circular.signed_by: Loknath Behera IPS, Director General of Police & State Police Chief, Kerala
kerala_circular.purpose: Strict implementation of Motor Vehicles (Driving) Regulations, 2017
distribution: Transport / Road Safety Commissioner, Govt. of Kerala
IGP Traffic & RSM / Zonal SPs - Traffic
All Officers in PHQ / PIC PHQ / Web admin SCRB

definitions.carriageway: Part of road normally used by vehicular traffic
definitions.construction_zone: Section of roadway where construction activity is in progress or declared to be undertaken
definitions.heavy_vehicle: Heavy goods vehicle or heavy passenger motor vehicle as per Section 2(16) and 2(17) of the Act
definitions.intersection: Any level crossroad, junction or fork, including open areas formed by such crossroads
definitions.longitudinal_marking: Road marking provided along the movement of traffic on carriageway
definitions.major_district_roads: Important roads within a district notified by the State Government
definitions.major_road: Highway, road or street designated as such by highway or local authority
definitions.national_highways: Highways specified in National Highways Act, 1956 schedule or declared under Section 2(2)
definitions.parking: Bringing vehicle to stationary position and causing it to wait for any purpose other than immediate pick-up/drop; includes stopping for more than 3 minutes
definitions.rider_or_passenger: Person travelling on a motor vehicle other than as driver
definitions.right_of_way: Right of vehicle or road user to proceed in preference to another approaching in circumstances of danger or collision
definitions.road: Includes bridges, tunnels, lay-bys, ferry facilities, interchanges, roundabouts, traffic islands, dividers, all lanes, ramps, toll plazas, roads under construction; excludes private roads
definitions.road_marking: Lines, patterns, words on carriageway or kerbs for controlling, warning, guiding road users
definitions.road_user: Person driving or travelling on road in a vehicle or otherwise; includes pedestrians
definitions.silence_zone: Area notified by competent authority where use of sound signal is prohibited
definitions.state_highways: Arterial roads of a State notified as such by State Government
definitions.stopping: Halting vehicle for very short duration to allow passengers to board/alight or for quick loading/unloading
definitions.traffic: Vehicles, carriages, pedestrians, processions, animals and all other forms of road traffic
definitions.traffic_island: Physical provision and road markings at or near intersections to regulate vehicular traffic
definitions.traversed_marking: Road marking provided across the carriageway

regulations.title: Duty towards other road users and general public
rules: No vehicle shall be driven, stopped or parked in a manner likely to endanger safety or cause inconvenience to other road users

regulations.title: Use of roads by vehicles
rules: Every moving vehicle must have a driver
Motor vehicle shall be driven on the carriageway
On dual carriageways, drive on left carriageway unless directed otherwise
Keep vehicle as far left as possible; allow opposite traffic to pass on right
Keep left when being overtaken, approaching bends or hills with restricted view
Heavy/speed-restricted vehicles must use left lane; return after overtaking
One-way roads must be used only in the specified direction
No driving against traffic flow unless directed by authority
Keep safe distance from reversing vehicles

regulations.title: Duties of drivers and riders
rules: Drive with due care and caution at all times
Driver must be in full physical and mental control
Maintain good lookout; avoid distractions
Take special care for vulnerable road users: pedestrians, cyclists, children, elderly, differently abled
Ensure vehicle does not cause hindrance or inconvenience to others
Ensure view is not obstructed and hearing not impaired
Ensure all occupants wear seat belts
Children up to 12 years must be in appropriate child restraint system
Motor cycle riders, pillion-riders must wear helmet
No loud music in vehicle
No watching digital video/motion pictures while driving (navigation device allowed with care)
Strictly comply with laws on alcohol, drugs and smoking; ensure compliance by crew and passengers
Take care when getting into or out of vehicles
Do not drive a vehicle with known defects that could cause danger
If defect discovered while driving, take vehicle off road immediately
Motor cycle/three-wheeler rider shall not hold on to or push another vehicle
Motor cycle/three-wheeler driver must hold handlebar with both hands except when signalling

regulations.title: Lane traffic
rules: Drive within the lane; change lanes only after proper signal
Vehicles of a special class must use lanes marked for that class
No other vehicle may use a lane designated for a special class
Do not cross yellow or white solid longitudinal line while overtaking
At intersections with turning lanes, remain in the lane for the intended direction
Do not drive on solid single/double longitudinal lines or painted traffic islands except for obstructions
On roads with broken line alongside solid line, may cross broken line to overtake then return

regulations.title: Right of way
rules: At STOP sign: stop before stop line, give way to major road traffic, enter only when clear
At Give Way sign: slow down, give way to approaching traffic, proceed cautiously
Give way to pedestrians if no pedestrian crossing precedes STOP/Give Way sign
Vehicle emerging from property must give way to traffic on road

regulations.title: Left, right and U-turns
left_turn: Indicate intention clearly and in good time
Move to leftmost lane or slip lane before turning
Use direction-marked lane on multi-lane roads
Give way to cyclists and slow-moving traffic before turning left
Give way to pedestrians at uncontrolled crossings
right_turn: Indicate intention clearly and in good time
Move to rightmost lane before turning
Give way to pedestrians at uncontrolled crossings

prohibited_when: Prohibited by road sign or traffic signal
On a busy road with continuous traffic flow
On a major road, highway or expressway
Across a continuous single or double solid line
requirements: Ensure no blind spots around vehicle
Closely observe traffic in opposite direction and mirrors
Give way to all road users including pedestrians and cyclists
Ensure clear view of approaching traffic
Large vehicle may take U-turn from left lane only where permitted

regulations.title: Precautions at intersections
rules: Slow down at road intersections, junctions, pedestrian crossings and road corners
Do not enter intersection if likely to endanger other road users
Vehicles from the right have right of way at intersections (unless controlled by lights/signs/authorized person)
Do not enter a standstill intersection even with a green signal

regulations.title: Precautions at roundabouts
rules: Traffic already in roundabout has right of way
Choose appropriate lane before entering based on exit direction
Use indicators when changing lanes within roundabout
Follow left-turn procedure when exiting roundabout

regulations.title: Indication of signals
rules: Clearly indicate intention to change course or turn before any manoeuvre
Use mechanical/electrical devices or hand signals

hand_signals.stop: Raise right forearm vertically outside and to the right of vehicle, palm to the right
hand_signals.turn_right: Extend right arm horizontally outside to the right, palm turned to the front
hand_signals.turn_left: Extend right arm and rotate it anti-clockwise
hand_signals.signal_to_overtake: Extend right arm horizontally to the right and swing arm backward and forward in semi-circular motion

regulations.title: Traffic control signals
red_light: Stop before stop line preceding pedestrian crossing
If no stop line, stop before pedestrian crossing
If no pedestrian crossing, stop before primary traffic signal
Move with caution after green signal
Flashing red: treat as STOP sign; give way to pedestrians and major road traffic
Left turn allowed on red after giving way to right-side traffic and pedestrians (unless prohibited)
green_light: Enter intersection only if way ahead is clear
Follow direction of green directional arrow if displayed
Give way to pedestrians within intersection and vehicles already in intersection
Flashing green arrow: turn in direction of arrow after giving way to pedestrians, cyclists and merging vehicles
amber_light: Stop before stop line preceding pedestrian crossing
If no stop line, stop before pedestrian crossing
If no pedestrian crossing, stop before signal (unless crossing stop line would cause collision)
Flashing amber: slow down, proceed with caution after giving way

regulations.title: Manual traffic control
rules: Follow directions of police officer in uniform or authorised person
On STOP signal: stop before stop line preceding pedestrian crossing
If no stop line, stop before pedestrian crossing
If no pedestrian crossing, stop before the approaching road at junction
Do not move until signal to proceed is given

regulations.title: Overtaking
rules: Overtake only when safe and not in violation of law
Overtake only from the right side
Left overtaking allowed: on multi-lane roads in a safe left lane; when vehicle ahead is turning right; when vehicle ahead is stationary
Do not overtake if it impedes oncoming traffic
While overtaking, drive faster than vehicle being overtaken but within speed limits
Do not overtake if traffic situation is unclear
Do not overtake across continuous solid longitudinal lines
Do not overtake on bends, corners, obstructions, junctions, intersections, pedestrian crossings
Do not overtake where road narrows, on narrow culverts, or in School/Hospital/Construction zones
Do not overtake where prohibited by mandatory traffic signs
Use direction indicators to show intention to overtake; return to left side quickly after
Do not give right indicator to signal permission for following vehicle to overtake
Outside built-up areas: signal by short horn blast or headlight flasher before overtaking
Vehicle being overtaken shall not increase speed or impede overtaking vehicle

regulations.title: Merging in traffic
rules: Give way to existing traffic when entering national/state highway or major district road
At intersection of two same-category roads, vehicle on right has right of way
Use acceleration lane to build up speed before merging
Watch rear and side-view mirrors and signal before merging
Do not overtake ahead vehicle unless you have stayed long enough in left/current lane

regulations.title: Speed
rules: Drive only at a speed that allows full control of vehicle at all times
Drive at lower speed during fog, rain, snowfall, storm or desert winds
Do not exceed maximum speed limit or go below minimum speed limit
Do not drive so slowly as to impede normal traffic flow
Do not exceed 25 km/h near construction sites, schools, hospitals (where indicated) or roads without footpaths used by pedestrians

regulations.title: Keeping safe distance
rules: Maintain sufficient following distance to stop safely if vehicle ahead brakes suddenly
Do not brake suddenly without compelling reason when being followed
Increase following distance during adverse weather (rain, snow, storm, ice)

regulations.title: Restrictions on driving in reverse
rules: Do not reverse on a road unless necessary to turn around; ensure safety of others
No vehicle shall be driven onto a public road in reverse direction
No vehicle shall reverse into a ONE WAY road

regulations.title: Level crossings
rules: Rail-borne vehicles have overriding priority at all unmanned level crossings
Slow down when approaching a railway crossing
Do not park or overtake within barriers of a railway crossing; keep to left
At guarded crossing: do not enter after gates have started closing or when facing red light
At unguarded crossing: enter only after ensuring no rolling stock is in sight
Buses, goods vehicles, tractors with farm labour/goods, and hazardous material vehicles must stop and send person to check crossing before proceeding

regulations.title: Entering a tunnel
rules: Switch on dipped lights before entering a tunnel
No overtaking, U-turns or reversing inside a tunnel
Do not stop or park in a tunnel unless unavoidable; if unavoidable, switch on hazard lights and place reflective triangles 20 metres from vehicle on both sides

regulations.title: Vehicles going uphill to be given precedence
rules: On mountain/steep narrow roads, driver going downhill must stop on left side and allow uphill vehicle to pass first

regulations.title: Stopping and parking
no_stopping_zones: Where road is narrow or view is obstructed
Near or on a sharp bend
On or within 5 metres before a pedestrian crossing
Within 5 metres before traffic light signal, Give Way or STOP sign
On a yellow box marked on road
Where prohibited by mandatory No Stopping sign
no_parking_zones: On main road where speed limit is 50 km/h or more
On footpath, cycle track or pedestrian crossing
Within 50 metres of an intersection or junction
Where it blocks access to designated parking spaces
Near bus stop, entrance to educational institution or hospital, or near traffic sign or fire hydrant
In front of entrance or exit of a property
Where there is a continuous yellow line on the kerb side
If likely to obstruct any vehicle or cause inconvenience
Beyond specified duration in time-limited parking zones
In category-restricted parking if vehicle doesn't qualify
In differently-abled reserved spaces by non-disabled drivers
In a manner that occupies excessive space in a designated lot
Where prohibited by No Parking sign

regulations.title: Use of horns and silence zones
rules: Unnecessary use of horn is prohibited
Horn to be sounded only when driver apprehends danger
Sound horn when directed by mandatory sign
Do not sound horn continuously, repeatedly or for longer than necessary
Do not use horn in residential areas or silence zones
Do not use cut-out to release exhaust gases other than through silencer
Do not fit or use air horn or multi-toned horn giving harsh, shrill or alarming noise
Do not drive a vehicle that creates undue noise when in motion

regulations.title: Mandatory orders
rules: Driver must comply when stopped by police officer for verification of fitness certificate or collection of information
Obey directions given by mandatory signages, road markings and signalling devices
Obey signals or instructions of police officer on duty in uniform regardless of other rules
Obey verbal directions of police officer including to stop, reverse, slow down, turn back, or keep in specific lane

regulations.title: Passing along formations
rules: Reduce speed and pass slowly and cautiously past funeral processions, troop/police formations, or pack animals
Leave adequate space between formation and vehicle
Stop and allow formation to cross if it is crossing or about to cross the road

regulations.title: Bar on traffic impairment
rules: No driver shall offer goods or services on the road
No driver shall display any advertisement on the vehicle (unless validly permitted)

regulations.title: Vehicles designated for emergency duties
rules: Emergency vehicle siren and flasher to be used only when responding to actual emergency
Emergency vehicle with siren and flasher on has right of way over all other vehicles
In utmost emergency, emergency vehicle may: cross red light, exceed speed limit, drive on hard shoulder, drive on NO ENTRY or One Way street — all with extreme caution
Other vehicles must yield to emergency vehicle: move left to kerb and stop until it has passed
Maintain at least 50 metres distance from an emergency vehicle with siren/flasher on
Road/utility maintenance vehicles parked on roadway must switch on hazard lights and place warning device at least 50 metres behind
emergency_vehicle_priority: 4th: Other State Government designated emergency management vehicles (water, power, public transport)

regulations.title: Vehicle breakdown
rules: Switch on hazard warning lights immediately
On highways and major fast roads, place reflective warning triangles 50 metres behind broken-down vehicle
If broken down on a bend, place reflective triangles before the bend

regulations.title: Action in case of vehicular accident
minor_accidents: Alight and take pictures of vehicles, occupants, pedestrians and accident scene if possible
Pull vehicles off the road immediately
Place reflective warning triangles and turn on hazard lights
Call police or ambulance immediately if anyone is hurt
Do not leave the scene until everything is resolved
major_accidents: Call medical assistance and police immediately if someone is hurt
Take pictures of persons, vehicles, registration plates and scene once stabilised
Move vehicles to side of road if possible
If cannot move vehicle, remain at scene until police arrives (unless injured)
Exchange details with other driver: name, address, phone, insurance company, policy number, driving licence number, vehicle registration number
interacting_with_other_driver: Refrain from losing temper or provoking others
Call police immediately if amicable settlement cannot be made
Remain at scene if police has been informed until permitted to leave

regulations.title: Towing a vehicle
rules: No two-wheeled motor vehicle shall be towed by another vehicle
Maximum towing speed: 25 km/h
Maximum distance between towing and towed vehicle: 5 metres
Tow ropes or chains shall be clearly visible to other road users
Display retro-reflective ON TOW sign (min. 10 cm height, 2 cm width, 2 cm letter spacing on white background) at front of towing vehicle and rear of towed vehicle
Do not tow at night, in darkness or adverse weather unless hazard lights of both vehicles are on
If hazard lights of towed vehicle are non-functional, towing vehicle's hazard lights must be on

regulations.title: Vehicle lighting
rules: Use specified lighting at nightfall, night, dawn and when visibility is poor
Two-wheeled motor vehicle drivers must keep dipped headlights on during daytime also
All lighting devices must be kept in good working condition and unobstructed
Do not drive with parking lights only (unless directed by authority)
Do not use high beam inappropriately, for long durations or on well-lit roads
Dip high beam in good time when approaching oncoming vehicle or driving close behind another
Use fog light headlamps only in low visibility conditions (fog, dust, storm, rain, snow) and only with dipped headlamps

regulations.title: Driving of tractors and goods vehicles
rules: Tractor driver shall not carry any person on the tractor
Number of persons in driver's cabin of goods carriage shall not exceed the number in certificate of registration
No person shall be carried in a goods carriage for hire or reward

regulations.title: Lane splitting (lane within a lane)
rules: In urban areas on roads with max speed limit of 40 km/h, motor cyclists may filter between 3 and 4-wheeled vehicles where specifically permitted by road signs
Speed difference between motor cyclists and other vehicles must not exceed 15 km/h

regulations.title: Restriction on carriage of dangerous substances
rules: Driver of public service vehicle shall not carry or allow any person to carry explosive, highly inflammable or dangerous substances except the vehicle's own fuel and lubricants

regulations.title: Projection of loads
rules: Loads must be stowed and restrained so they cannot slip, fall, roll, fall off or produce avoidable noise even during emergency braking or sudden swerve
Do not drive a vehicle loaded in a manner likely to cause danger to any person
Load shall not extend beyond the sides, front, rear or height/weight limits in the certificate of registration

regulations.title: Registration plates
rules: No vehicle shall be driven or parked without displaying registration plates as prescribed by law
Registration plates must be clearly visible, legible and unobstructed
No letters, words, figures, pictures or symbols other than the registration number shall appear on the plates
No load shall hide the registration plate

regulations.title: Use of mobile telephones and communication devices
rules: Driver shall not use any hand-held mobile phone or other communication device while driving
No trainer or supervisor shall use a mobile phone or communication device while training or supervising a learner driver

regulations.title: Production of documents
regulations.hazardous_goods_vehicle: Additional documents as per rules 132 and 133 of Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989
non_transport_vehicle: Certificate of registration and insurance (originals or photocopies)
regulations.production_on_demand: Must produce documents on demand by police officer, Motor Vehicles Department officer or authorised State Government officer
regulations.note: If original registration or insurance certificate not available, produce before competent authority within 15 days if required

regulations.title: Pedestrian crossings, footpaths and cycle tracks
rules: Slow down, stop and give way to pedestrians, invalid carriage users and wheelchair users at uncontrolled pedestrian crossings
Do not drive onto pedestrian crossing if traffic is at standstill and you are unlikely to clear the crossing
No vehicle shall drive on a footpath or cycle track except on direction of police officer or where traffic signs permit

regulations.title: Knowledge and understanding of road signs, markings, traffic control signals, the Act and the Rules

general: Road signs, markings and traffic control signals

Section 113: Limit of weight and limitations on use
